note: EXAMPLE ONLY, with made-up numbers. The real file is fitted from your own proxy meter readings and local Claude/Codex session logs (see reproduction). Only account-a@example.com's weekly_fable meter is marked usable (the tests expect one usable Fable meter); it matches no real account, so the token estimate gives no figure for your records until you fit your own.
units: percentage points of each source meter; pooled category values use boxes.toml weights

token_semantics.input: uncached input; subtract cached_input_tokens from raw Codex input_tokens once
token_semantics.output: includes reasoning; never add reasoning_output_tokens again
token_semantics.cache_write_1h: optional subset of cache_write; 2x input prior instead of 1.25x

method.fit: nonnegative least squares on non-overlapping approximately 40-minute meter differences
method.reset_handling: drop any provider-meter decrease or reset-epoch change greater than 120s; never count reset drop as negative consumption
method.excluded_intervals: gaps >30m, resets, provider meters outside [0,100], or >5% unattributed API-style token signal

reproduction: Read original Claude assistant usage; globally deduplicate message.id and take per-field maximum across streamed records.
Read Codex cumulative total_token_usage within each session: take positive differences; for first/reset record use last_token_usage; ignore unchanged totals.
Subtract cached_input_tokens from Codex inclusive input; output already includes reasoning.
Match model/time against proxy account selections without assuming priority order. Keep overlapping accounts unassigned.
For each meter, retain all readings and first-seen old/new steps. Reject reset/gap/out-of-range intervals and >5% unknown signal.
Sum tokens and signed meter changes in adjacent nonoverlapping >=40m blocks, preserving partial blocks at gaps.
Transform token types with fixed existing API-style ratios. Fit nonnegative family slopes with coordinate descent.
Train only on intervals ending before a cutoff; test only on intervals starting after it. No crossing interval used in validation.
Refit accepted/candidate slopes on all eligible blocks. Codex uses ridge lambda 10 toward training pooled slope; unsupported Luna slope stays unpublished.
Category estimates use weekly Fable, derived own-half 2A-F non-Fable, and weekly Codex. Five-hour meters constrain the same usage and are never added.
